disclaimer.label: About adoption through FOA
disclaimer.body: Friends of Animals facilitates adoption. The organisation that lists an animal is responsible for it, for its care until it goes home and for the adoption itself.

meta.title: Adopt an animal
meta.description: Dogs, cats and other animals looking for a home, listed by organisations FOA has verified.

browse.title: Adopt an animal
browse.lead: Animals looking for a home, listed by rescuers and organisations FOA has verified. Each one's page says who to talk to.
browse.count: {count, plural, =0 {No animals match} one {# animal on this page} other {# animals on this page}}
browse.empty: No animal matches these filters right now. Try fewer filters, or come back soon.

animal.onHold: On hold: an adoption is being discussed, or this animal needs time. You can still ask about it.
animal.adopted: Adopted: this animal has found a home.
animal.organisationBody: {organisation} listed {name}. Their page has their contact details.
animal.applyBody: Friends of Animals' adoption coordinator reads your application and puts you in touch with {organisation} if it looks like a good match. You need to be signed in and an adult.

forbidden.title: You can't manage these animals
forbidden.body: Only the representatives of a verified directory listing manage its animals.

manage.notVerified: Your listing isn't verified right now, so its animals are hidden and can't be published or changed.

meta.title: Animals for adoption
meta.description: The animals your listing offers for adoption.

list.title: Animals from {name}
list.lead: Add an animal, give it photos and publish it on /adopt. Drafts stay private.
list.name: Animal

new.title: Add an animal
new.lead: Write what an adopter needs to know. It stays a private draft until you add a photo and publish it.

meta.title: Edit an animal
meta.description: Change what an animal's page says.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.lead: Changes to a published animal show at once.

meta.title: Manage an animal
meta.description: Photos, publishing and details of one animal.

notices.created: Saved as a draft. Add a photo, then publish.
notices.held: On hold: it is out of the list, and its page says so.

animal.photosLead: Up to {max} photos. Each needs a short description for people who can't see it. Photos show once they are checked and resized, in a minute or two.

blockers.no_photo: Add a photo and wait until it is ready before publishing.
blockers.directory_not_verified: Your listing must be verified to publish.

animal.holdHint: Takes it out of the list while an adoption is discussed. Its page stays, marked on hold.
animal.withdrawHint: Takes it down for good. Use this if it has gone home another way, or won't be adopted.
animal.closed: This listing is closed. Its details can't change.

errors.invalid_transition: That can't be done to this animal now. The page shows where it is.
errors.directory_not_verified: Your listing must be verified for that.
errors.last_photo: A published animal keeps at least one ready photo. Add another first.
errors.invalid_input: Something in the request wasn't right. Try again.

upload.title: Add a photo
upload.limits: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 15 MB.
upload.altHint: For people who can't see it, up to 150 characters: for example, "Bruno lying in the sun".
upload.uploaded: Uploaded. It shows here once it is checked and resized.

errors.type_not_allowed: Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
errors.too_many_photos: This animal has the most photos it can have. Remove one first.
errors.directory_not_verified: Your listing must be verified to add photos.
errors.upload_failed: The upload didn't finish. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You can't add photos to this animal.

name.label: Name
name.error: Give a name of up to 60 characters.

age.label: Age, about
age.hint: A guess is fine. Its page keeps the age up to date.
age.error: Give 0 to 60 years and 0 to 11 months.

about.label: About the animal (optional)
about.hint: Character, habits, how it is with people and other animals.

conditions.label: Adoption conditions
conditions.hint: What you ask of an adopter: a home visit, an indoor home, a follow-up call.
conditions.error: Write the adoption conditions, up to 2,000 characters.

city.label: City or town
city.error: Give a city of up to 80 characters.

alerts.invalid_input: Some answers need fixing. They are marked below.
alerts.directory_not_verified: Your listing must be verified to list animals.
alerts.listing_closed: This listing is closed. Its details can't change.

organisationLink.title: Animals for adoption
organisationLink.body: List animals that need a home. They show on /adopt while your listing is verified.
